shutdown.validationBoundary: After the first frame and readiness report, the observer closes the game window as a player would and waits for the original stdin script console thread to stop before exiting; stdin stays open and silent, like an idle console, until that report and then reaches end of file; sources are unchanged

fileLookup.semantics: Windows-style case-insensitive file lookup for the game process

compatibility: The original MinGW 4.8/Qt 5.2 headers made <functional> available transitively (several historical headers use std::function without including it); libstdc++ 5 does not, so every recipe force-includes <functional>.
